blueprint_binding.title: Blueprint: HarnessPro Pareto RSI lessons and P0 Foundation CI verification economics

same_task: Given an exact commit SHA, a supplied list of check names/App IDs, and a supplied GitHub check-runs snapshot, report exact-name/SHA/App observation counts and outcomes.

contract_comparison.finding: Binds one Actions workflow run/jobs snapshot to a component-validation plan, selected targets, artifact inventory, and optional receipt. It does not consume GitHub check-runs rows to classify exact check name/SHA/App ID observations.
Summarizes per-job/per-step timestamps from one supplied run/jobs snapshot. It does not compare requested check contexts or GitHub App IDs.
Compares repeated job/step sequences across 2-20 context-matched workflow runs. It does not assess exact check-run name/SHA/App binding.

same_task_observation: The live PR #264 check-run snapshot produced two unique exact name/SHA/App success observations and one requested context name with no exact observation. Existing tools accept different input/output contracts and do not produce this per-context result.
findings: The new tool has a narrow additional capability for exact check-run name, SHA, and App observation classification.
It neither replaces interval analysis nor plan/target/artifact attribution; all existing Actions tools retain their distinct uses.
A successful observation does not establish required-check satisfaction, CI sufficiency, reusable evidence, merge/release permission, or scientific validity.
The evidence supports optional coexistence and no retirement; performance and analyst-effort comparisons remain unknown.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Classify caller-supplied GitHub check-run records against explicit commit SHA, check name, and GitHub App ID pairs while preserving missing, stale, wrong-provider, duplicate, pending, and non-success states.

disposition.action: Keep this tool and the compared Actions tools optional and default-off; do not retire or replace any comparator.

claim_ceiling: Offline contract and same-task comparison. The tool does not authenticate sources, establish branch protection, prove required checks, estimate savings, or authorize a CI/release decision.
